notes.title: Additional columns
notes.content:
This catalog includes several columns added on top of the original Rubin data products:

  • Magnitude and magnitude error columns converted from fluxes: nested columns diaSource.psfMag and diaSource.scienceMag, and nested column diaObjectForcedSource.psfMag, each with a corresponding error column. The magnitude error is defined as half the difference between the magnitudes corresponding to Flux ± FluxErr.
  • Four new nested columns: diaObjectForcedSource.psfFluxErr_corrected, diaObjectForcedSource.psfDiffFluxErr_corrected, diaObjectForcedSource.psfFluxErr_corrected_flag, and diaObjectForcedSource.psfDiffFluxErr_corrected_flag, produced by a model trained to correct flux errors for non-variable objects so their reduced χ² is close to unity. These corrected values may be useful for light-curve fitting; the flag is set when the ratio between the original and corrected error is outside the [0.1, 50] interval (details in Malanchev et al., in prep.; source code on GitHub).
  • Nested column diaObjectForcedSource.psfMagErr_corrected, derived from psfFluxErr_corrected the same way the other magnitude errors are derived from flux errors.
  • Nested column diaObjectForcedSource.midpointMjdTai, joined from the visit table for the corresponding visit.

diaSource rows whose diaObjectId does not appear in the DiaObject table are not included in the nested light curves: 8,136,150 of 1,000,825,975 rows (0.81%).

Some float64 columns were downcast to float32 to reduce catalog size. Downcast columns: g_psfFluxMax, g_psfFluxMaxSlope, g_psfFluxMean, g_psfFluxMeanErr, g_psfFluxMin, g_psfFluxSigma, g_scienceFluxMean, g_scienceFluxMeanErr, i_psfFluxMax, i_psfFluxMaxSlope, i_psfFluxMean, i_psfFluxMeanErr, i_psfFluxMin, i_psfFluxSigma, i_scienceFluxMean, i_scienceFluxMeanErr, r_psfFluxMax, r_psfFluxMaxSlope, r_psfFluxMean, r_psfFluxMeanErr, r_psfFluxMin, r_psfFluxSigma, r_scienceFluxMean, r_scienceFluxMeanErr, u_psfFluxMax, u_psfFluxMaxSlope, u_psfFluxMean, u_psfFluxMeanErr, u_psfFluxMin, u_psfFluxSigma, u_scienceFluxMean, u_scienceFluxMeanErr, y_psfFluxMax, y_psfFluxMaxSlope, y_psfFluxMean, y_psfFluxMeanErr, y_psfFluxMin, y_psfFluxSigma, y_scienceFluxMean, y_scienceFluxMeanErr, z_psfFluxMax, z_psfFluxMaxSlope, z_psfFluxMean, z_psfFluxMeanErr, z_psfFluxMin, z_psfFluxSigma, z_scienceFluxMean, z_scienceFluxMeanErr, diaSource.dipoleAngle, diaSource.dipoleChi2, diaSource.dipoleFluxDiff, diaSource.dipoleFluxDiffErr, diaSource.dipoleLength, diaSource.dipoleMeanFlux, diaSource.dipoleMeanFluxErr, diaSource.extendedness, diaSource.ixx, diaSource.ixxPSF, diaSource.ixy, diaSource.ixyPSF, diaSource.iyy, diaSource.iyyPSF, diaSource.snr, diaSource.timeProcessedMjdTai, diaSource.trailAngle, diaSource.trailDec, diaSource.trailLength, diaSource.trailRa.
